definitions.near_black: At least 99% of pixels have all channels ≤5/255.
definitions.near_black_excess: Near-black output while its target is not near-black; heuristic, not a proof of failure.
definitions.all_black: Every channel of every pixel equals zero.
definitions.worse_copy: Strictly worse primary score than copying query input, tolerance 1e-12.
definitions.validation: October 12 selected recipe, 17 queries/task; different dataset composition and demonstrations. Shared query IDs are removed from the sensitivity view, not original scores.
